title: Add Comment Thread
content: Create comment thread. Comment: flex gap-3, avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), content area. Content: bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-3, author name (font-semibold), comment text, actions row (reply, like, timestamp). Replies: ml-12 mt-2 space-y-2 (nested under parent). Reply input: flex gap-2, avatar, textarea, submit button. Load more: "View X more replies" link.

variants.simple: Create nested comment thread with replies.
variants.detailed: Create comment thread. Comment: flex gap-3, avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), content area. Content: bg-gray-100 rounded-lg p-3, author name (font-semibold), comment text, actions row (reply, like, timestamp). Replies: ml-12 mt-2 space-y-2 (nested under parent). Reply input: flex gap-2, avatar, textarea, submit button. Load more: "View X more replies" link.
variants.advanced: Create full comment system. Comment structure: avatar, author info (name, badge if author/mod), timestamp (relative, hover for full), comment body, actions. Voting: upvote/downvote buttons with count, highlight own vote. Actions: reply, edit (own comments), delete (own), report, share/copy link. Nested replies: indented with connecting line, configurable max depth, collapse/expand for deep threads. Reply input: appears inline when Reply clicked, @mention autocomplete, submit/cancel buttons. Edit mode: inline editing, Save/Cancel, "Edited" indicator after save. Delete: confirmation dialog, shows "[deleted]" for comment with replies. Author badges: OP (original poster), MOD, ADMIN, verified, custom flair. Rich content: markdown support, code blocks, embedded media, link previews. Reactions: emoji reactions beyond votes, click to add reaction. Sorting: newest, oldest, most upvoted, controversial. Pagination: "Load more comments" or infinite scroll, "Load X new comments" for real-time updates. Collapsing: minimize threads, "collapsed by moderator" for hidden content. Keyboard navigation: j/k to navigate comments. Accessibility: proper nesting semantics, screen reader announcements for actions.
